title: Meet the team and our new Advisor
author: Branch Executive Committee
summary: Mr. Tabingwa Evans Maganda joins the branch as Advisor, alongside Branch Counselor Dr. John Bosco Ssemakula.
content:
The branch welcomes Mr. Tabingwa Evans Maganda as Advisor to the branch executive.

He joins Dr. John Bosco Ssemakula, the Branch Counselor, in the branch's governance and advisory group. The Counselor is the faculty member who advises the branch on behalf of IEEE and the university.

The student executive is led by Chair Mulondo Andrew, with officers covering administration, finance, technical work, programmes and outreach. Meet everyone on the Team page: /team
